title: Framework Default Hidden Panels
description: By default, framework side panels should be hidden. Wire Platform.initialPanelVisibility into views and sync toggles with Platform.panelVisibility.
summary: Framework side panels default to hidden. Added PanelVisibility and resolveInitialPanelVisibility in @framework/core; Platform applies PlatformSpec.initialPanelVisibility to panelVisibility. PlatformView and PlaygroundView resolve visibility from props or platform spec and sync toggles via Platform.setPanelVisibility. Play puzzle runtimes pass initialPanelVisibility when opting in.
